# Imgram Bot API

Imgram is an independent chat service with a Telegram-style Bot API subset. Imgram bot tokens are not Telegram tokens and must never be sent to api.telegram.org.

Canonical API root: https://bot.premsir.com
Method URL: https://bot.premsir.com/bot<TOKEN>/<METHOD>

Start here: https://github.com/kidrauhl123/imgram-bot-api/blob/main/CONNECT.md
API reference: https://github.com/kidrauhl123/imgram-bot-api/blob/main/BOT_API.md
Compatibility: https://github.com/kidrauhl123/imgram-bot-api/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY.md
OpenAPI: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kidrauhl123/imgram-bot-api/main/openapi.json

Supported methods:
getMe, sendMessage, sendChecklist, editMessageText, deleteMessage,
pinChatMessage, unpinChatMessage, toggleChecklist, appendChecklist,
getUpdates, setWebhook, deleteWebhook, getWebhookInfo.

Only documented methods and fields are supported. Prefer raw HTTP for v1. OpenClaw is experimental; stock CC Connect and Hermes integrations require adapters.
